name: 对门行
The Rival House
before: 荒原路口新开了一家大商行，门匾上写着「对门行」，专跟老秤作对：老秤报海市的价，他们就压低一成。商行的东家雇了一伙蜃骑和刀客守门，又派伙计天天抄海市上的买卖，抄了满满一屋。今天他们要把老秤的客人全拦下，一个也不许过路。

At a crossroads on the plain a big new trading house has opened, its sign reading 'The House Across the Way', and it exists to undercut Old Scale: whatever he calls for the sea market, they call ten per cent less. The owner has hired mirage riders and swordsmen to guard the door and sends clerks out daily to copy down every deal in the sea market, a whole room of copies by now. Today they mean to stop every one of Old Scale's customers on the road.
after: 刀客散了，东家把抄本摊开求饶。抄本里有一页是千里号那天买的东西：草帽三百顶，淡水三十桶，琵琶弦一副，还有「女童鞋一双，绣小鱼」。阿汐盯着那一行看了很久：「我小时候，鞋上就绣小鱼。」

The swordsmen scatter and the owner spreads out his copies, begging for mercy. One page lists what the Qianli bought that day: three hundred straw hats, thirty casks of fresh water, a set of lute strings, and 'one pair of girl's shoes, embroidered with little fish'. Axi stares at that line a long time. 'When I was small, my shoes had little fish on them.'

name: 念词街
Script Street
before: 复日城的长街上，人人照着词说话，一句不多，一句不少。可今天词卡住了：卖鱼的喊到一半，忘了下一句；城门口的老头张着嘴，想不起千里号的人从哪边进城。管词的是更夫老梆，带着一队镇丁和几个蜃兵沿街巡查，谁说错了就往城外撵。他们正揪着一个小丫头：她说了一句词里没有的话，「明天见」。

On Same-Day Town's long street everyone speaks from the script, not a word more, not a word less. But today the script is sticking: the fishmonger stalls halfway through his cry, the old man at the gate stands with his mouth open, unable to remember which way the Qianli's people came in. The keeper of the script is the night watchman Old Clapper, patrolling the street with town wardens and a few mirage soldiers, throwing out anyone who gets it wrong. They have hold of a little girl who said something that isn't in the script: 'See you tomorrow.'
after: 镇丁被打退，小丫头躲到你们身后。她是卖糖老汉的孙女，生在那一天之后，词里根本没有她，她只好自己说话。老梆翻着他那本磨破的词本，嘴里念念有词：天上那一天糊了好几块，他拿自己的记性一块块补，「补不上的，就是没了」。

The wardens are driven back and the little girl hides behind you. She's the sweet seller's granddaughter, born after that day, so the script has no part for her and she has to say things of her own. Old Clapper leafs through his worn script book muttering: several patches of the day in the sky have blurred, and he fills each one from his own memory. 'What I can't fill is gone.'

name: 过街影
Passing Shadows
before: 每天辰时，海市的影子落到岸上这条大街，一队人从客栈走向码头：挑担的、扛桶的、抱琵琶的，有说有笑，正是十年前千里号的人。街上的真人都给影子让路。一伙海盗混在影子里抢东西，抢完往影子背后一躲，追的人一刀砍下去，砍的是一片光。

Every morning at the Dragon hour the sea market's shadow falls across this street ashore, and a file of people walks from the inn to the harbour: men with carrying poles, men with casks, someone hugging a lute, laughing and chatting. The Qianli's people, ten years ago. The living on the street step aside for them. A pirate band mixes in among the shadows to rob, then ducks behind them, and whoever gives chase cuts at nothing but light.
after: 海盗被一个个从影子里揪出来。影子照旧往码头走，走在最后的是个黑脸汉子，眯着眼看海，手里提着一双绣小鱼的小鞋。阿汐冲上去，从他身上穿了过去。她站在街当中，回头望着那个背影：「爹，鞋小了。」

The pirates are dragged out of the shadows one by one. The shadows walk on toward the harbour as before, and last of all comes a dark-faced man squinting out to sea, carrying a pair of little shoes embroidered with fish. Axi runs at him and passes straight through. She stands in the middle of the street, looking back at him. 'Dad, they're too small now.'

name: 听市坡
Market-Listening Slope
before: 岸边一道缓坡，清早海上冷、天上暖，海市的声音能一路滚到坡上来：吆喝、算盘、铜锣，听得清清楚楚。一伙海盗在坡上搭了几座听棚，一个人听一炷香收五文，还雇了几个蜃弓手守着，不交钱的人连坡都不许上，说「声音也是货」。

A gentle slope above the shore. On early mornings, cold sea below and warm air above, the sea market's sounds roll all the way up here: hawkers' cries, abacus beads, gongs, every one distinct. A pirate band has put up listening booths and charges five coppers for an incense stick's worth of listening, with a few mirage archers to keep out anyone who won't pay. 'Sound is goods too.'
after: 海盗被撵下坡，听棚拆了，大家坐在草里白听。小桨闭着眼听了半天，忽然坐直：一片吵嚷底下，有人在哼歌，是鲛人礁上那支歌。阿汐的手攥紧了：「是我爹。他每晚在船上哼，十年前那一天也哼过。」原来那天的声音也被记了下来，一直在海上转。

The pirates are run off the slope, the booths come down, and everyone sits in the grass listening for free. Xiaojiang listens a long while with his eyes shut, then sits bolt upright: under all the clamour someone is humming, the song from Mermaid Reef. Axi's hands clench. 'That's my father. He hummed it every night aboard, and that day too.' So the sounds of that day were kept as well, and have been circling out at sea ever since.

name: 更楼
The Watch Tower
before: 复日城最高处是一座更楼，每天天不亮，老梆就在楼上敲第一更，城里人听见梆子声就起床，开始过八月廿五。楼下守着镇丁和一队蜃兵，人数不少，谁也不许碰那面梆子。今天老梆见你们上来，把梆子抱在怀里：「这一天不能断。断了，她回来就找不着地方了。」

At the top of Same-Day Town stands a watch tower, and every day before dawn Old Clapper beats the first watch there; hearing the clapper, the town rises and begins living the twenty-fifth of the eighth month again. Town wardens and a squad of mirage soldiers guard the foot of the tower in strength, and no one may touch the clapper. Seeing you come up, Old Clapper hugs it to his chest. 'This day can't be broken. If it breaks, she won't find the place when she comes back.'
after: 这一回镇丁和蜃兵都散了。老梆坐在楼梯上，说出了那一天：千里号的人进城，沈船主把满市的货都买了下来，付了现银，说「替后来的人留着」；傍晚她站在城楼上说，「明天照常开市」。第二天船走了，海市就挂上了天，再也没有那样的好日子。「我们就一直照常着。」卖糖老汉的孙女把一块糖递给你们，喊了一声：「八月廿六，新糖，五文！」那是十年来头一句新词。可城里还有一半人舍不得那一天，过不了几日，又会有人摸上更楼，替老梆敲梆子，镇丁又会聚起来。你们还得再来。

This time the wardens and mirage soldiers scatter. Old Clapper sits on the stairs and tells the day as it was. The Qianli's people came to town, and Captain Shen bought up the whole market's goods, paid in silver, and said, 'Keep them for those who come after.' At dusk she stood on the gate tower and said, 'Open the market tomorrow as usual.' Next day the ships left, the sea market went up into the sky, and there was never a day so good again. 'So we've gone on as usual ever since.' The sweet seller's granddaughter hands you a sweet and calls, 'Twenty-sixth of the eighth month! New sweets, five coppers!' It's the first new line in ten years. But half the town can't bear to let that day go; before long someone will climb the tower to beat the clapper for Old Clapper, and the wardens will gather again. You'll have to come back.

name: 蜃母湾
Mirage Mother Cove
before: 海湾边住着一伙老海盗，个个白了胡子，打不动劫，就在湾口收「问路钱」：问海市怎么去，一两；问海市是什么，二两。领头的是个缺牙的老婆婆，海盗们都喊她娘。她坐在礁上嗑瓜子，身边站着一圈蜃兵，嘴里还哼着小调。

A band of old pirates lives by the cove, every beard gone white, too old for raiding, so they charge 'asking money' at the cove's mouth: one tael to ask the way to the sea market, two to ask what it is. Their leader is a gap-toothed old woman the pirates all call Mother. She sits on a rock cracking melon seeds, ringed by mirage soldiers, humming a little tune.
after: 蜃兵散了，老海盗们缩成一团，老婆婆倒不慌，二两的那句白送给你们：老辈人说，海里有一只大蜃，蛤蜊那样的，大得看不见边，它一吐气，天上就起楼。「它吐的不是气，是它记得的事。那天它记住了，就天天吐。」她吐出一片瓜子皮：「老东西，记性也该不好了。」

The mirage soldiers scatter and the old pirates huddle together, but the old woman stays calm and gives you the two-tael answer for nothing. The old folk say there's a great shen in the sea, a clam, so big no one can see its edges, and when it breathes out, towers rise in the sky. 'It's not breath it breathes. It's what it remembers. It remembered that day, so it breathes it out every day.' She spits out a seed husk. 'An old thing like that. Its memory must be going too.'

name: 翌日茶棚
Next-Morning Tea Shed
before: 路边一座茶棚，棚主是从复日城搬出来的一家人，不肯再过那一天，在这儿卖茶过自己的日子。城里的镇丁恨他们坏了规矩，带着几个蜃骑隔三岔五来砸棚，说「出城的人，不许提那一天」。今天茶壶又被砸了，棚主的儿子拿扁担堵在门口。

A tea shed by the road, kept by a family who moved out of Same-Day Town; they won't live that day again and sell tea here to live their own. The town wardens hate them for breaking the rule and come every few days with mirage riders to smash the shed: 'Those who leave town don't speak of that day.' Today the teapot's been smashed again, and the owner's son blocks the door with a carrying pole.
after: 镇丁和蜃骑被打跑了，茶棚又烧开了水。棚主说城里人只记得廿五，他家记得廿六：「那天一早，千里号五条船往东走，满海都是雾。船一走，海市就上了天，像是有谁替我们记下了。」他给你们倒了一碗茶：「过日子，得往后过。」

The wardens and riders are run off and the shed boils water again. The owner says the town remembers only the twenty-fifth, but his family remembers the twenty-sixth. 'Early that morning the Qianli's five ships headed east through sea fog. The moment they left, the market went up into the sky, as if someone had written it down for us.' He pours you a bowl of tea. 'Living means going forward.'

name: 站箱台
Crate-Top Stand
before: 每天正午，海市散之前，天上会映出一幕：一个腰挂短刀的女人站上一只木箱，对满市的人说话，市上的人都停了手。岸上这块平地正对着那一幕，一伙海盗在这里卖「看戏票」，还雇了一队蜃兵挡住不买票的人。今天正午快到了，人越聚越多，海盗把票价翻了一倍。

Every day at noon, just before the sea market fades, one scene plays in the sky: a woman with a short blade at her waist steps up on a wooden crate and speaks to the whole market, and everyone stops what they're doing. This patch of ground ashore faces the scene squarely, and a pirate band sells 'show tickets' here, with mirage soldiers to block anyone who hasn't paid. Noon is close, the crowd is growing, and the pirates have doubled the price.
after: 海盗被打散，大家站着看那一幕。天上的沈渡一字一句，声音隔着海传过来：「货我付了，替后来的人留着。我们要往东去，路长，人的记性短。谁替我记着路，我就替谁记着账。」说完，她朝海里深深一揖。老秤说：「天天这一揖，我一直不知道她拜的是谁。」

The pirates scatter and everyone watches the scene. The Shen Du in the sky speaks word by word, her voice carrying over the water: 'I've paid for these goods. Keep them for those who come after. We're going east. The road is long, and people's memories are short. Whoever keeps the road in mind for me, I'll keep their accounts for them.' Then she bows deeply toward the sea. Old Scale says, 'That bow, every single day, and I've never known who she was bowing to.'

name: 叼货鸥
Snatching Gulls
before: 海边一片礁滩上空，几百只海鸥盘旋，叫声刺耳。一伙海盗训了这群鸥，专从过路人筐里叼东西：叼钱袋、叼布头、叼包子。驯鸥的海盗站在礁上吹哨，哨一响，鸥群就扑下来，还有几个蜃弓手在礁顶放箭，替鸥群开路。

Over a stretch of rocky shore hundreds of gulls wheel and scream. A pirate band has trained the flock to snatch from passers-by's baskets: purses, cloth, buns. The gull master stands on a rock and blows a whistle, and at the sound the flock dives, while a few mirage archers on the rocks loose arrows to clear their way.
after: 驯鸥的海盗被捆了，哨子也折了，鸥群乱飞了一阵，飞回礁上去了。海盗说这群鸥最初是叼不着东西的：它们天天往海市里飞，扑个空，饿得直叫，他才想到驯它们抢人。「鸟比人老实，扑了十年空，它们早知道那是假的。」

The gull master is tied up, his whistle snapped, and after some aimless circling the flock settles back on the rocks. He says at first the gulls couldn't snatch anything: every day they flew into the sea market and came up empty, screaming with hunger, and that gave him the idea of training them on people. 'Birds are more honest than men. Ten years of empty dives, and they've long known it isn't real.'

name: 后来仓
Latecomers' Warehouse
before: 海岬尽头一座石砌的大仓，门上刻着「千里号付讫，后来者取」。十年来一伙海盗想进仓，进不去：仓门是三道铁闩，钥匙在老秤手里。他们干脆在仓外扎了营，海盗最凶的一批守着，还养了一群蜃兵蜃骑，谁靠近就围上来，等老秤哪天松口。

At the tip of the headland stands a great stone warehouse, its door carved: 'Paid in full by the Qianli. For those who come after to collect.' For ten years a pirate band has tried to get in and failed: the door has three iron bars and Old Scale holds the keys. So they've camped outside, their fiercest men on guard with a herd of mirage soldiers and riders, surrounding anyone who comes near, waiting for the day Old Scale gives in.
after: 海盗被打散，老秤掏出三把钥匙。仓里码着三百顶草帽、成匹的布、一箱箱针线，每样都贴着「丁未年八月廿五」。角落里一只小木盒，装着一双绣小鱼的女童鞋，盒盖上写：「给阿汐，长大了穿。」阿汐把鞋捧在手里，又哭又笑：「爹，你算错了，我长得太快了。」

The pirates are broken and Old Scale brings out three keys. Inside are three hundred straw hats, bolts of cloth, crate after crate of needles and thread, every item labelled 'Twenty-fifth day, eighth month, Dingwei year.' In a corner is a small wooden box holding a girl's shoes embroidered with little fish, and on its lid: 'For Axi, to wear when she's grown.' Axi holds them in her hands, crying and laughing at once. 'Dad, you got the sum wrong. I grew too fast.'

name: 等落船
Waiting-for-the-Fall Fleet
before: 海市底下的海面上泊着一大片海盗船，船挨着船，桅杆像一片林子。他们听信了一个说法：等那只老蜃死了，天上的集就会一下子掉进海里，满海都是货。于是全泊在这儿等，等了好几年，船底都长满了藤壶。蜃兵在他们的甲板上巡逻，看见你们的船就敲起了锣。

On the sea beneath the market rides a crowd of pirate ships, hull against hull, masts like a forest. They believe a story: when the old shen dies, the market in the sky will drop into the sea all at once and the water will be full of goods. So they all anchor here and wait, and they've waited years, their hulls thick with barnacles. Mirage soldiers patrol their decks, and at the sight of your ship the gongs start beating.
after: 海盗船队被打散，起锚逃了一大半。被俘的老舵工说，天上的集真在往下沉：他刚来时，海市离海面有三根桅那么高，如今只剩一根半。「蜃老了，楼就低了。」他往东边看了一眼，「再低下去，就落进海里，什么也没有了。」

The pirate fleet is broken and most of it weighs anchor and flees. A captured old helmsman says the market in the sky really is sinking: when he first came it hung three masts high above the water, and now it's a mast and a half. 'The shen is old, so the towers are low.' He glances east. 'Any lower and it'll drop into the sea, and then there'll be nothing.'

name: 旧市基
Old Market Footings
before: 海边一片荒地，地上横着一排排石墩，半埋在沙里，像一片矮矮的墓碑。这是真的旧蜃港集市，十年前就败了，海口淤成了沙。一伙海盗在这里挖了好几年，说当年的商人走得急，地底下埋着银子，他们拉了一大队蜃兵蜃骑守着工地，不许别人插手。

A waste of land by the shore, rows of stone plinths lying half buried in sand like a field of low gravestones. This is the real old market of Mirage Harbour, failed ten years ago when its harbour mouth silted up. A pirate band has been digging here for years, sure the merchants left in a hurry with silver buried underfoot, and they keep a big troop of mirage soldiers and riders on guard so no one else can cut in.
after: 海盗被赶跑，挖开的坑里只有碎瓦。老秤一墩一墩地数，在第十九号石墩前站住了：墩面上刻着一行字，刀刻的，很深，「千里号于此付清。沈」。天上海市里沈渡站的那只木箱，就摆在这一墩上。墩子是真的，那一天也是真的。

The pirates are chased off and their pits hold nothing but broken tiles. Old Scale counts the plinths one by one and stops at number nineteen. A line is cut deep into its face with a knife: 'The Qianli settled in full here. Shen.' The crate Shen Du stands on in the sky market sat on this very plinth. The stone is real, and so was the day.

name: 海市
The Sea Market
before: 辰时，海市出来了，这一回不在天上：海口退潮，旧市基上搭起了新棚，十几家真商户把货摆出来，跟天上那一天对着价。一伙海盗带着最后的蜃兵蜃骑扑上来，要把棚子掀了：真集开了，他们的抽水、听棚、看戏票就都没了。老秤坐在第十九号石墩上，膝上搁着秤，等着开秤。

At the Dragon hour the sea market appears, and this time not in the sky: the harbour mouth is at low tide, new stalls stand on the old market footings, and a dozen real merchants set out their goods, matching prices with that day overhead. A pirate band charges in with the last of its mirage soldiers and riders to tear the stalls down: once a real market opens, their skimming, listening booths and show tickets are finished. Old Scale sits on plinth number nineteen with his steelyard on his knees, waiting to open the scale.
after: 海盗被打下了海，老秤提起秤杆，报了十年来头一个新价，木料换铁器的买卖重新做了起来，每天一万五千。天上的海市还在，只是淡了，正午那只木箱上的人影，今天没有出来。老秤看了看天：「她那一幕没了。」他把十年的账本交给你们一本：「最后一天的总数是一百零三样。往东去吧，蜃要是记不住了，总得有人替它记。」

The pirates are driven into the sea. Old Scale lifts his steelyard and calls the first new price in ten years, and the trade of timber for metalwork starts up again, fifteen thousand a day. The market in the sky is still there, only faint, and today at noon no figure stepped up on the crate. Old Scale looks up. 'Her scene is gone.' He hands you one of his ten years of ledgers. 'The last day's total was a hundred and three items. Head east. If the shen can't remember any more, someone has to remember for it.'

name: 截市口
Market Mouth Raid
before: 新海市开了没几天，海口就来了一伙外海的海盗，驾着快船，专劫往海市送货的船：他们不知道天上那一天，只知道这里有了真集，真集就有真钱。快船上还挂着几个蜃兵，远远看去船上人头攒动，近了才知道一半是空的。

The new sea market has been open only a few days when a pirate band from the outer sea turns up at the harbour mouth in fast boats, preying on the ships bringing goods in. They know nothing of the day in the sky; they only know there's a real market here now, and a real market means real money. Their boats carry a few mirage soldiers too, crowded with heads from afar, half empty up close.
after: 快船被打退了，送货的船一条条进了海口。船上的商户说，天上的海市这个月又少了一块：千里号那几个摊子，上个月还在，这个月不见了。「天上的忘一块，地上的就得记一块。」老秤叫人把那几个摊子卖的货，一样样抄在了第十九号石墩上。

The fast boats are beaten off and the supply ships come into the harbour one after another. Their merchants say another piece of the sky market went this month: the Qianli's few stalls were there last month and gone this one. 'Whatever the sky forgets, the ground has to remember.' Old Scale has every item those stalls sold copied onto plinth number nineteen.

name: 讨忆屋
House of the Asked-Back Memory
before: 海边一间小屋，住着个老寡妇。十年前她在换忆摊上拿一段事换了一面铜镜：她男人出海前那天早上的样子。换完镜子，男人的脸就想不起来了。如今她天天拿着镜子去换忆摊，要把那段事换回来，可摊前守着一伙海盗，把她连人带镜子推倒在沙里。

A little house by the shore where an old widow lives. Ten years ago at the memory-swap stall she traded something for a bronze mirror: how her husband looked the morning before he went to sea. Once she had the mirror, she couldn't recall his face. Now she takes the mirror to the stall every day to trade the memory back, but a pirate band guards the stall and has shoved her, mirror and all, into the sand.
after: 海盗被赶走了。换忆摊的老掌柜看了看铜镜，摇摇头：换出去的事，他也没了，交给了海里那个「记事的」。可那天早上，天上的海市里正好有一个渔夫在码头上回头笑。老寡妇举着镜子对着天，看了很久：「是他。我记住了，这回不换了。」

The pirates are driven off. The old merchant at the stall looks at the mirror and shakes his head: memories traded away aren't with him either, they went to 'the one who keeps things' in the sea. But that morning, in the market in the sky, a fisherman on the quay happened to look back and smile. The old widow holds her mirror up to the sky and looks a long time. 'It's him. I've got it now, and I'm not trading it again.'

name: 东望滩
East-Gazing Strand
before: 海岸往东拐的地方有一片长滩，滩头扎着一伙海盗的营，营里还剩些蜃兵，可这些蜃兵站着站着就淡了，像被水洗过的画，有的只剩半截身子。海盗们自己也慌了，说这阵子吐兵的那位不大灵光，吐出来的兵连刀都忘了拿。

Where the coast turns east lies a long strand, and a pirate camp sits at its head, a few mirage soldiers still among them. But the soldiers fade as they stand, like paintings washed by water, some only half there. The pirates themselves are rattled: lately whoever breathes the soldiers out isn't quite right, they say, and the ones it breathes forget to bring their swords.
after: 海盗营被打散。老秤一路跟到这里，站在滩头往东看：天上的海市越来越淡，残下的几座楼都朝东歪。「楼往那边歪，那边就是它。」他把秤杆往东一指：东边山脚下有一座蜃楼市舶司，簿子上记着你们一路的买卖，「它记不住的，那里有人在替它记」。

The pirate camp is broken. Old Scale has followed you this far, and he stands at the head of the strand looking east: the market in the sky grows fainter, and its last few towers all lean east. 'The towers lean that way, so that's where it is.' He points his steelyard east: at the foot of the eastern mountains stands a Mirage Customs House whose books record every trade you've made on the road. 'What it can't remember, someone there is writing down for it.'

name: 旱字堡
Fort of the Dry Banner
before: 沙里半埋着一座土堡，堡墙上还插着一面褪成灰白的旗，旗上一个「旱」字。一伙海盗占了土堡，夹着一队蜃兵蜃弓手守在墙头，拿堡里的旧刀枪跟过路的商人换酒。他们看见你们的灯笼先是一愣，接着大笑：「又来一个后千里？上个月那个给的是假银子！」

Half buried in the sand stands an earthen fort, a banner faded to grey-white still flying from its wall, bearing the character for 'Dry'. A pirate band holds it with a squad of mirage soldiers and archers on the walls, trading the fort's old weapons to passing merchants for wine. They see your lanterns, stare for a moment, and then roar with laughter. 'Another Houqianli? The one last month paid in fake silver!'
after: 海盗被打出了堡。堡里的木牌刻着「旱海军左营」，兵册挂在墙上，一千零一个名字，最后一个是「军主卫长庚」。被捆的海盗说，上个月真来过一伙「后千里」，也挂三百盏灯，也报你们的名字，「比你们还像」。龚墨斗的脸黑了。

The pirates are thrown out of the fort. A wooden board inside reads 'Dry Sea Army, Left Camp', and the muster roll still hangs on the wall: one thousand and one names, the last 'Commander Wei Changgeng'. A trussed-up pirate says a 'Houqianli' really did come through last month, three hundred lanterns and all, giving your names. 'They looked more like you than you do.' Gong Modou's face goes dark.

name: 千人锅
Pot for a Thousand
before: 沙窝里支着一口大铁锅，大得能坐进去三个人，锅下烧着骆驼刺，锅里咕嘟着一锅粥。烧锅的是个独臂老兵，人称瓢叔，每天熬一锅够一千人吃的粥，熬好了敲三下锅沿，喊「开饭」，可从来没人来。一伙海盗天天来白吃，今天吃完了，还要把锅抬走卖铁。

In a sandy hollow sits a huge iron pot, big enough for three men to sit in, camelthorn burning under it and congee bubbling inside. The cook is a one-armed old soldier everyone calls Uncle Ladle. Every day he boils enough congee for a thousand men, strikes the rim three times and calls 'Food's up!', and no one ever comes. A pirate band comes daily to eat for free, and today, done eating, they mean to carry the pot off and sell it for scrap.
after: 海盗被打跑，锅保住了。瓢叔说他是旱海军的伙头，十年前军主卫长庚领兵沿海岸护过五条船，三天三夜，兵举着火把站在浅滩上，替船标出水道。船进了蜃楼，朝廷的饷就断了，营散了。「军主走的时候说，天天开饭，人会回来。」他又敲了三下锅沿。

The pirates are chased off and the pot is saved. Uncle Ladle says he was the Dry Sea Army's cook. Ten years ago Commander Wei Changgeng led the army along the coast escorting five ships, three days and nights, the men standing in the shallows with torches to mark the channel. Once the ships went into the Mirage the court's pay stopped and the camp broke up. 'When the Commander left, he said: keep serving food every day and the men will come back.' He strikes the rim three times again.

name: 认账村
Village of the Unpaid Bill
before: 大路边一座村子，村口的人看见你们的灯笼，抄起锄头就围上来：「后千里又来了！上回赊了二十头猪，一文没给！」村里雇了一伙刀客和蜃骑守村口，就为了堵「后千里」，一见你们，二话不说就扑了过来。

A village on the high road. At the sight of your lanterns the people at its edge grab hoes and close in. 'Houqianli's back! Last time they took twenty pigs on credit and never paid a copper!' The village has hired swordsmen and mirage riders to hold its gate for the sole purpose of keeping 'Houqianli' out, and the moment they see you they charge without a word.
after: 刀客败了，村长才肯拿出赊条。龚墨斗一看就跳脚：赊条上签的是「后千里龚墨豆」，字歪得像蟹爬。「我的名字都写不对，还敢冒我的船！」你们照赊条把猪钱垫上了。村长红着脸说，那伙人往南边沙地去了，船是装在车轮子上的。

Only once the swordsmen are beaten will the headman bring out the credit slip. Gong Modou takes one look and stamps: it's signed 'Houqianli, Gong Mo-bean', in a scrawl like a crab's tracks. 'They can't even write my name and they dare pass off my ship!' You pay the pig money on the slip. Red-faced, the headman says that lot went south into the sands, and their ship was on wheels.

name: 点鼓场
Drum-Roll Ground
before: 沙地上一片旧校场，场边立着一面破牛皮鼓，一个瘸腿老兵每天天不亮就来擂鼓，冲着空场点名，点一千个名字，一个也不漏。一伙海盗把校场当了货场，堆满抢来的粮，嫌老兵吵，拉了一队蜃兵围着鼓，要把鼓皮划了。老兵抱着鼓槌，嗓子已经喊哑了。

An old drill ground in the sand, a battered oxhide drum at its edge, and every day before dawn a lame old soldier comes to beat it and call the roll to an empty field, a thousand names, not one missed. A pirate band uses the ground as a depot heaped with stolen grain, and fed up with the noise they've set mirage soldiers around the drum to slash its skin. The old man clutches his drumsticks, hoarse from shouting.
after: 海盗和蜃兵被打散，鼓保住了。老兵叫老鼓，旱海军的鼓手。他说军主走前留的最后一道令是「原地待命」，他就天天点名。点到一半，你们抬头一看：东边天上浮出一片军阵，正跟着他的鼓点操练，一千个人，一个也不少。

The pirates and soldiers are scattered and the drum is saved. The old man is called Old Drum, the Dry Sea Army's drummer. The last order the Commander gave before he left was 'Hold position and await orders', so he calls the roll every day. Halfway through, you look up: in the eastern sky a formation of troops has floated up, drilling to his beat, a thousand men, not one missing.

name: 镜海
Mirror Sea
before: 一场雨过后，盐滩上积了薄薄一层水，平得像一面镜子，天上的云、远处的山都倒映在里面，人走在上面像走在天上。可镜子里的人影跟你们不一样：你们站着，倒影在走；你们向东，倒影向西。倒影里还有一排排兵，扛着旗，从水面底下一个个站了起来，是蜃兵。

After rain a thin film of water covers the salt flat, smooth as a mirror; clouds and far mountains lie in it upside down, and walking on it is like walking on the sky. But the figures in the mirror don't match you: you stand and your reflections walk; you go east and they go west. And among the reflections are rows of soldiers bearing banners, rising one by one up out of the water: mirage soldiers.
after: 蜃兵碎成了一地水光。水面又平了，倒影这才跟你们对上。阿汐蹲下来看：天上的那片军阵倒映在镜海里，旗上是「旱」字，兵的脸都年轻，一个也没老。「蜃王记得他们十年前的样子。」老鼓在远处擂着鼓，水里的兵就跟着鼓点抬脚。

The mirage soldiers shatter into scattered sparkles. The water smooths out and only now do your reflections line up with you. Axi crouches to look: the formation in the sky is mirrored in the Mirror Sea, the banners marked 'Dry', the soldiers' faces all young, not one aged. 'The Mirage King remembers them as they were ten years ago.' Far off Old Drum beats his drum, and the soldiers in the water lift their feet to the rhythm.

name: 双船会
Meeting of Two Ships
before: 荒原上迎面驶来一条「船」：船底装着八只大车轮，几十头驴拉着，桅上挂着三百盏灯笼，船尾写着「后千里」。船头站着的人跟龚墨斗一般高，也叼着烟袋；旁边一个丫头也捧着潮信簿；还有个半大小子趴在船舷上，学小桨听浪。他们的海盗水手看见你们，愣了半天，随即抄起家伙冲下了船。

Across the plain a 'ship' comes toward you: eight big cartwheels under the hull, dozens of donkeys hauling, three hundred lanterns on the mast and 'Houqianli' on the stern. The man at the bow is Gong Modou's height and has a pipe in his teeth too; beside him a girl holds a tide book; a gangly boy lies across the rail pretending to listen to waves like Xiaojiang. Their pirate crew gape at you for a long moment, then grab their weapons and pour down off the ship.
after: 假水手们败了，假龚墨斗把烟袋一扔，自报家门：海盗影七。一个月前他在天上看见一条船，倒挂着，三百盏灯，人脸都看得清，「那会儿你们还在雾里呢」。他照着天上的样子扎了这条车船，一路冒名吃白食。龚墨斗绕着车船看了一圈，气得直乐：「舵装反了。」

The fake crew is beaten and the fake Gong Modou flings down his pipe and names himself: the pirate Ying Qi. A month ago he saw a ship in the sky, upside down, three hundred lanterns, every face aboard plain to see. 'You were still in the fog then.' He built this wheeled ship after the picture in the sky and has been eating free all along the way on your name. Gong Modou walks round the cart-ship once, so angry he laughs. 'The rudder's on backwards.'

name: 升旗崖
Flag-Raising Cliff
before: 海边一道高崖，崖顶立着一根旗杆，每天日出，一个白发老兵把一面「旱」字旗升上去，日落再降下来，十年没断过。一伙海盗嫌这面旗招眼，怕引来官兵，天天在崖下放箭射旗，旗上早已满是窟窿。今天他们爬上了崖，要把旗杆砍倒。

A high cliff by the sea with a flagpole on top, and every sunrise a white-haired old soldier raises a banner marked 'Dry' and lowers it at sunset, never missing a day in ten years. A pirate band hates the banner for being so conspicuous, afraid it'll bring soldiers down on them, and shoots at it daily from below until it's more hole than cloth. Today they've climbed the cliff to cut the pole down.
after: 海盗被赶下崖，老旗手把破旗又升了上去。他说营散那年，军主挑了十个人，划一条小船往东北海上那座冒烟的岛去了，说是去取千里号留给旱海军的一样东西，「取回来，就有人来接我的班了」。船去了，没回来。他每天升旗，是给岛上的人看的。

The pirates are thrown off the cliff and the old flag-bearer runs the tattered banner up again. The year the camp broke up, he says, the Commander picked ten men and rowed a small boat to the smoking island out in the north-east sea, to fetch something the Qianli had left for the Dry Sea Army. 'Once I've fetched it, someone will come to relieve me,' he said. The boat went and didn't come back. He raises the flag every day for the people on that island to see.

name: 陷轮沙
Wheel-Trap Sands
before: 影七的车船跑了一半人，剩下的一伙海盗赶着车船往南逃，逃进一片沙地，八只轮子陷进沙里，几十头驴拉不动。他们干脆把车船当了堡垒，躲在船舷后头放箭，船上的三百盏灯笼一盏盏点起来，晃得人睁不开眼。

Half of Ying Qi's cart-ship crew has run, and the rest drive it south and into a stretch of sand, where all eight wheels sink and dozens of donkeys can't shift it. So they turn the cart-ship into a fort and shoot from behind its rails, lighting its three hundred lanterns one by one until the glare makes it hard to see.
after: 车船上的海盗被一个个拖了下来。舱里堆满了一路白吃白拿来的东西：猪肉、米、布，每样都贴着一张「后千里赊」。你们把东西装上车，一样样还回去，认账村的猪钱也有了着落。龚墨斗把那块写着「后千里」的船尾板卸了下来，扛在肩上：「这名字，他们不配。」

The pirates on the cart-ship are dragged down one by one. Its hold is piled with everything they've taken on credit and never paid for: pork, rice, cloth, each tagged 'On Houqianli's account'. You load it onto carts to return item by item, and the pig money for the Village of the Unpaid Bill is settled too. Gong Modou takes down the stern board painted 'Houqianli' and shoulders it. 'They don't deserve this name.'

name: 靴冢
Boot Mound
before: 沙地上插着一片靴子，一双挨一双，靴口朝天，排得整整齐齐，像一片矮矮的树。附近的人说这是旱海军散营那天留下的，谁也不许动。可一伙拾荒的海盗看中了靴子的牛皮，一双双拔出来往筐里扔，还拉了几个蜃兵在旁边放哨。

A field of boots stands planted in the sand, pair beside pair, mouths to the sky, in neat ranks like a little forest. Locals say the Dry Sea Army left them the day the camp broke up and no one may touch them. But a band of scavenging pirates has its eye on the oxhide and is pulling them up pair by pair and tossing them into baskets, with a few mirage soldiers keeping watch.
after: 拾荒的海盗被打跑了，靴子一双双插了回去。老鼓赶来，一排排数：九百九十双，少十一双。「军主和那十个人穿着靴子走的。」他说散营那天，大家把靴子脱下来插在这儿，约好军主回来，就回来穿上，接着当兵。靴子里落满了沙，一双也没被人领走过。

The scavengers are chased off and the boots are planted back one pair at a time. Old Drum arrives and counts row by row: nine hundred and ninety pairs, eleven short. 'The Commander and his ten went in theirs.' The day the camp broke up, he says, everyone took off their boots and planted them here, agreeing that when the Commander came back they'd return, put them on, and soldier on. The boots are full of sand, and not one pair has ever been reclaimed.

name: 军饷亭
Pay Pavilion
before: 大路边一座小亭子，亭里摆着一张桌子，桌上一只空钱箱，箱上贴着「旱海军饷，按月领取」。一个老书办每月初一坐在亭里，等朝廷的饷车，等了十年。一伙海盗占了亭子，冒充旱海军的老兵来领饷，拿不到钱，就拿老书办出气，还请了一队蜃兵把亭子围了。

A little pavilion by the high road with a table inside and on it an empty cash box labelled 'Dry Sea Army pay, collect monthly'. On the first of every month an old pay clerk sits here awaiting the court's pay cart, and has done for ten years. A pirate band has taken the pavilion, posing as Dry Sea veterans to collect pay, and when there's no money they take it out on the clerk, with a squad of mirage soldiers circling the place.
after: 海盗被打跑，老书办扶正了帽子。他翻开饷册：最后一笔饷是十年前八月，底下有军主的批，「千里号过蜃，护之，此月饷不必报兵部」。原来那三天三夜，是军主自己做的主，朝廷知道了，第二个月就断了饷。「他拿一营人的饷，换了五条船过蜃。」

The pirates are run off and the old clerk straightens his hat. He opens the pay register: the last pay was ten years ago in the eighth month, with the Commander's note beneath. 'The Qianli to be escorted through the Mirage. This month's pay need not be reported to the Ministry of War.' So those three days and nights were the Commander's own decision; when the court learned of it, the pay stopped the next month. 'He traded a whole camp's pay for five ships through the Mirage.'

name: 影七寨
Ying Qi's Den
before: 沙地背风的一面藏着一座寨子，是影七一伙的老窝，寨墙上也挂着三百盏灯，比你们船上的还亮，寨门口立着一块牌子：「后千里分号」。寨里的海盗听说车船丢了，把剩下的人马全调了上来，还雇了一大队蜃兵蜃弓手，寨墙上下站得满满的。

On the lee side of the sands hides a stockade, the old lair of Ying Qi's crew, its walls also hung with three hundred lanterns, brighter than the ones on your ship, and a sign at the gate: 'Houqianli, Branch Office'. Hearing they've lost the cart-ship, the pirates inside have called up every man they have and hired a big troop of mirage soldiers and archers, and the walls are packed from top to bottom.
after: 寨子被打破，海盗跑了一大半。寨里有一面大铜镜，镜面朝天：影七就是拿它看天上的影子，看一样学一样。镜子底下压着一摞画，画的都是天上映出来的东西，有你们的船，有千里号的五条船，还有一条小船，十个人在划，船头站着一个披甲的人。

The stockade falls and most of the pirates flee. Inside is a great bronze mirror facing the sky: this is how Ying Qi watched the pictures overhead and copied whatever he saw. Under it is a stack of drawings of things cast up in the sky: your ship, the Qianli's five ships, and a small boat rowed by ten men with an armoured figure standing in the bow.

name: 候代台
Relief-Awaiting Terrace
before: 海边一座石台，台上立着一块石碑，碑前插着一杆长枪，枪缨早烂光了。这是旱海军的点将台。一伙海盗在台上扎了营，把碑当了磨刀石，蜃兵在台下列阵，阵形整整齐齐，像是有人教过。碑上的字被刀磨得只剩半边。

A stone terrace by the sea with a stele on it and a long spear planted before the stele, its tassel long rotted away. This is the Dry Sea Army's reviewing terrace. A pirate band has camped on it and uses the stele as a whetstone, while mirage soldiers form up below in ranks so neat someone must have drilled them. The inscription has been ground down to half.
after: 海盗被赶下了台。老旗手拿袖子擦着残碑，念出了剩下的字：「千里号过蜃，护之。护毕，候代。卫。」护完了船，等人来接替。「他这个人，令没交出去，就不肯走。」老旗手望着东北海上那座岛：「十年了，没人来替他。」

The pirates are driven off the terrace. The old flag-bearer wipes the broken stele with his sleeve and reads what's left: 'The Qianli to be escorted through the Mirage. Escort complete, await relief. Wei.' Guard the ships, then wait for someone to take over. 'That man won't leave until he's handed his command on.' The old flag-bearer gazes at the island out in the north-east sea. 'Ten years, and no one's come to relieve him.'

name: 旱海粮仓
Dry Sea Granary
before: 沙地里一座土仓，是旱海军当年的粮仓，仓门上的封条还是十年前的。一伙从别处逃来的兵痞撕了封条，住进仓里，把仓里的陈粮拿去换酒，又堵了仓前的路，过路的人要么交粮，要么替他们推磨。看仓的老兵被他们关在了磨房里。

A mud granary in the sand, the Dry Sea Army's grain store, the seals on its door still those of ten years ago. A gang of deserters from somewhere else has torn the seals, moved in, traded the old grain for wine and blocked the road in front: travellers either hand over grain or turn their millstone. The old soldier who kept the store is locked in the mill room.
after: 兵痞被赶跑，老兵从磨房里出来，先去摸了摸仓墙。仓里剩的粮不多了，可每一袋都还写着营号，一营一袋，摆得整整齐齐。「军主说过，粮仓是兵的家，兵散了，家不能散。」他把仓门重新封上，封条上写的日子是今天。

The deserters are chased off and the old soldier comes out of the mill room and goes first to touch the granary wall. Not much grain is left, but every sack still bears its company number, one sack per company, in neat rows. 'The Commander said a granary is a soldier's home. The men may scatter, but the home mustn't.' He seals the door again, and the date on the new seal is today.
first: 仓里抄出兵痞换来的十坛烧酒、三十袋陈米、两车干柴，还有一面卷起来的旧军旗，兵痞拿它垫了床，旗角上绣着「旱海右营」。

From the granary you seize what the deserters traded for: ten jars of spirits, thirty sacks of old rice, two cartloads of dry firewood, and a rolled-up old army banner they'd used as a mattress, its corner embroidered 'Dry Sea Army, Right Camp'.
pass: 每次路过，看仓的老兵都按旱海军的规矩给你们发一份干粮，一人一份，不多不少，还要你们在粮册上按个手印：「领了军粮，就算半个旱海军的人了。」

Each time you pass, the old storekeeper issues you rations by Dry Sea Army rules, one share each, no more, no less, and has you press a thumbprint in the ration book. 'Draw army rations and you're half a Dry Sea man.'

name: 抓影营
Shadow-Catching Camp
before: 影七本人带着最后一伙海盗躲进了一座废营，营里点着火堆，火光照在一圈铜镜上，又照到天上，在营顶上映出一座更大的营，旗帜林立，号角声声。远处的人看了，都以为这里驻着千军万马。真守营的是几十个海盗和一大队蜃兵蜃骑。

Ying Qi himself has hidden with his last pirates in an abandoned camp. Bonfires blaze inside, their light thrown by a ring of bronze mirrors up into the sky, where a far bigger camp appears above the real one, banners thick, horns sounding. From afar people take it for a garrison of thousands. Its real defenders are a few dozen pirates and a big troop of mirage soldiers and riders.
after: 镜子被推倒，天上的大营没了，影七被捆了个结实。他耷拉着脑袋说，他学过天上那么多东西，就那条十个人划的小船学不了：「那船天天早上在天上出现一回，往东北岛上划，划到一半就没了。我扎了十条小船，划过去，岛上只有烟。」

The mirrors are pushed over, the great camp in the sky vanishes, and Ying Qi is trussed up tight. Head hanging, he says he's copied so many things from the sky, but the little boat rowed by ten men he couldn't. 'It shows up in the sky once every morning, rowing for the island in the north-east, and halfway there it's gone. I built ten little boats and rowed over, and on the island there was nothing but smoke.'
